question: Revenue deficit equals:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Revenue expenditure – revenue receipts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The revenue deficit is a measure of the shortfall in government income compared to its revenue expenditure.
 
• It is calculated using the formula: **Revenue deficit = Revenue expenditure – Revenue receipts**.
 
• Revenue expenditure refers to expenses incurred for day-to-day government activities, such as salaries, subsidies, and interest payments.</l
